verdict.rationale: Codegen docs explicitly state it can 'safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments,' directly matching the sandboxed-testing story. However, this is a single first-party doc line with no detail on how production-data isolation is enforced and no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: technical details on sandbox provisioning/data isolation guarantees, and third-party verification of the isolation claim.
